items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I was playing with Fletcher's band... we had guys in the band like... Kaiser Marshall

ctx.x: How was Fletcher to work for? Was he easy going or was he, again, pretty --

Oh, he was too easy a lot of times. You know, I can cite an instance in -- actually one time when I was playing with Fletcher's band, we were playing a series of one nighters up in Massachusetts, and this was when Fletcher's band was traveling by individual automobiles instead of a bus. And we had guys in the band like John Kirby, Coleman Hawkins, Louis Armstrong, Kaiser Marshall, Elmer Chambers and guys like that during that era, you know.

And they all had individual cars, and all Fletcher would tell them when they left New York, "We're playing up in Fall River, Massachusetts. It's on highway so and so.. We hit at 9:00 o'clock, and we're wearing such and such a thing." And he'd tell them this the night before. Okay, we don't see the guys no more.
